The *Vīriyalakkhaṇapañha* ("The Question on Energy", Mil 3.1.12) is a dialogue text belonging to the *Milindapañha* in the late Khuddaka Nikāya collection [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records four translations across three modern languages, including an English translation by John Kelly [SuttaCentral].

A full Chinese parallel exists in the Taishō Tripiṭaka as T 1670b 2.11 under the title *Exertion* [SuttaCentral].
